cohort: 11.6 million women in the United States who delivered singletons between 24 and 42 weeks' gestation from 2007 to 2010, excluding those with pregnancy-associated hypertension, fetal anomalies, previous cesarean delivery, or incomplete records
finding: The frequency of labor induction varies significantly by day of the week, with lower odds of induction on weekends, particularly at later gestational ages.
